name: deepagents
readme_excerpt: The batteries-included agent harness. Deep Agents is an open source agent harness — an opinionated agent that runs out of the box. Extend, override, or replace any piece. Principles: - Opinionated — defaults tuned for long-horizon, multi-step work - Extensible — override or replace any piece without forking - Model-agnostic — works with any LLM that supports tool calling: frontier, open-weight, or local - Production-ready — built on LangGraph (streaming, persistence, checkpointing) with first-c…
